login.title: Umuyoboro winjira
login.welcome: Murakaza neza! Injira kugirango uyobore ubuyobozi bwawe.
login.heroTitle: Kuza ubucuruzi bwawe butimukanwa hamwe nubuyobozi bwose uzanye
login.heroIntro: Umuyoboro umwe wo kwandikisha abakiriya hamwe nabubatsi, komeza inguzanyo kubyo uyobora hanyuma ubikurikire kugeza kubitabo.

protect.title: Kurinda kwigana
protect.text: Ubuyobozi bwawe buguma ubwawe mugihe cyo kurinda, ntamuntu rero ushobora gusaba umukiriya umwe.

track.title: Kurikirana buri cyiciro
track.text: Reba buri cyerekezo cyimiterere namateka yuzuye, kuva kubanza guhura kugeza kubitabo.

handover.title: Inguzanyo mu gutumaho
handover.text: Iyo ibitabo byabakiriya, icyerekezo gihabwa umwubatsi hamwe nawe wanditse nkumufatanyabikorwa winkomoko.

login.secure: Kwinjira neza - amakuru y'abakiriya bawe guma wenyine

signup.title: Kwiyandikisha kw'abafatanyabikorwa
signup.intro: Kora konte yawe kugirango utangire kwiyandikisha no gucunga inzira zawe.
